import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * Generated by QA-CRAWLER from the flow "Ouvrir une fiche".
 * Run status at generation time: not executed.
 * Test data is generated per run (never a recorded value); literal values of the flow and secrets come from the environment (QA_REPRO_<FLOW>_STEP_<n>).
 */
const runTag = `QA-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
const testData: Record<string, string> = {
};

test.describe("Ouvrir une fiche", () => {
  test("Ouvrir une fiche", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("http://127.0.0.1:9/");

    // step 1
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Utilisateurs" }).first().click();

    // step 2
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Utilisateur 1" }).first().click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp("/users/[^/]+"));
    await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: "Retour à la liste" }).first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: "Modifier" }).first()).toBeVisible();

    // step 3
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp("/users/"));

  });
});
